tool_limitations.limitation: The migration agent has no screenshot/pixel capability (parity + uwp-app-runner skills are disabled for it), so it cannot detect a blank-but-populated window; it can only see the UIA tree, which passes.

doc_errors.wrong: Recommends `{ThemeResource ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush}` as the opaque root Background and states a de-composed WinUI 3 window 'uses its normal opaque background'.
doc_errors.correct: `ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush` is a UWP-only theme resource; it is NOT defined in WinUI 3, so it resolves to null and leaves the root transparent. A WinUI 3 Window has no page background of its own — the content root must paint an opaque brush that EXISTS in WinUI 3 (e.g. `SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush`).

special_apis.special_handling: Correctly applied by the agent (PrintHelper.cs) per MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:336 — printing interop is already covered by the skill.

errors_encountered.error: Startup crash in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll during app launch
errors_encountered.root_cause: Invalid `{StaticResource}` theme-brush references in Styles.xaml that must be `{ThemeResource}` in WinUI 3.
errors_encountered.fix: Agent rewrote the offending Styles.xaml references to `{ThemeResource}` (build-events L959-L1012) and rebuilt; crash resolved.

errors_encountered.error: Every scenario renders a blank white window despite a fully populated UIA tree; MainWindow.xaml is clean (no SystemBackdrop, no TitleBar, no ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar).
errors_encountered.root_cause: The root Grid's `Background="{ThemeResource ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush}"` does not resolve in WinUI 3 (UWP-only brush) and the WinUI 3 Window has no default opaque page background, so nothing paints an opaque surface -> transparent root -> blank white capture.
errors_encountered.fix: NOT fixed by the agent (undetected). General fix: remap `ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush` to a WinUI 3 brush that exists and ensure the window content root paints an opaque background.

errors_encountered.error: App crashes when Printing the Photos scenario (Scenario 5), making Disable Preview (Scenario 6) unreachable.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Not captured — the migration agent never exercised the print path; the scorer observed the crash but no .NET exception type was recorded. Photos uses an async `GetPrintPreviewPage`/`AddPrintPages` path that loads BitmapImages from files.
errors_encountered.fix: Unknown — insufficient evidence to root-cause to a generalizable skill gap; printing interop itself is already correct.
